answer.summary: Winters says Eventbrite made the simple experience the default—automating Facebook ad targeting and creative with its data—while offering an on-ramp for creators who want to control and optimize those choices themselves. He said this gave both types of users an easy path to succeed, though the approach was not perfected.

sections.heading: Simple default, optional control
sections.content: Event creators were often not professional marketers. Eventbrite built a tool to automate their Facebook advertising, using Eventbrite’s data to improve results. The default experience handled targeting and creative for creators who wanted it done for them; creators who wanted to explore target segments and optimize creative could use an on-ramp to do more themselves. Winters said they had come to understand these different user types and created an easy path for both, while noting they had not perfected the approach.

judgment.explanation: The answer accurately describes the simple default that handles targeting and creative, plus an on-ramp for creators who want to manage and optimize those choices themselves. These points are supported by S2, and the answer appropriately notes that the approach was not yet perfected.
